text:
[3. AGENDA ITEMS]
[BFC 26-055] - The Department to provide an update regarding its response to the
  Mayor’s Executive Directive 22 Re: Addressing the Los Angeles Fire Department’s
  Response to Low-Acuity and Non-Emergency Calls for Service
summary: The Los Angeles Fire Department will give an update on how it is responding to a mayoral directive on handling low-acuity and non-emergency calls for service.

details.action: Department update on response to Mayor's Executive Directive 22
